messages.content: Read the three supplied original TRAIN fact texts and questions into the ordinary policy cache interface below. Return cases in the specified original ordinal order. The predicate names/roles/meanings are the actual cache model output, not a hand-written fixed legal API. Extract only assertions explicitly supported by the FACTS. Do not perform legal inference, guess missing facts, use the question as evidence for a legal assertion, or supply a final answer. An explicit statement that an individual qualifies under a particular section may be represented by the matching interface proposition; infer no composite qualification from an ordinary kinship fact alone. Respect claimant/subject order, polarity and year. Every nonneutral fact quote must be a nonempty exact substring of its own facts. The neutral case_subject_year relation may use names and year explicitly present in facts OR question and may quote that public text. Query predicate/arguments express what was asked, not an answer. Null projects a person not asked for, not a guessed person. Policy output amounts are strings. Do not invent legal predicates absent from the supplied interface. Missing evidence is unresolved/omitted, never an explicit false. No code, tools, browsing or outside materials.

{"interface": [{"functional": false, "meaning": "Neutral roster of the persons and taxable years actually named in the case or query; it supplies no substantive legal fact.", "name": "case_subject_year", "roles": ["person", "taxable_year"]}, {"functional": false, "meaning": "The child is a qualifying child of the claimant for the claimant's taxable year; the omitted section 152(c) tests are outside this module.", "name": "qualifying_child", "roles": ["child", "claimant", "claimant_taxable_year"]}, {"functional": false, "meaning": "The relative is a qualifying relative of the claimant for the claimant's taxable year; the omitted section 152(d) tests are outside this module.", "name": "qualifying_relative", "roles": ["relative", "claimant", "claimant_taxable_year"]}, {"functional": false, "meaning": "The section 152(a) dependent definition applies because the subject is the claimant's qualifying child or qualifying relative for the taxable year.", "name": "section_152a_applies", "roles": ["subject", "claimant", "claimant_taxable_year"]}, {"functional": false, "meaning": "The subject is a dependent of the claimant for the claimant's taxable year.", "name": "dependent", "roles": ["subject", "claimant", "claimant_taxable_year"]}, {"functional": false, "meaning": "The person's specified taxable year begins in the specified calendar year.", "name": "taxable_year_begins_in_calendar_year", "roles": ["person", "taxable_year", "calendar_year"]}, {"functional": false, "meaning": "Section 152(b)(1) applies to an individual who is another claimant's dependent, for the individual's taxable year beginning in the same calendar year.", "name": "section_152b1_applies", "roles": ["ineligible_individual", "claimant", "claimant_taxable_year", "ineligible_individual_taxable_year", "calendar_year"]}, {"functional": false, "meaning": "Section 151(c) applies because the subject is the claimant's dependent for the taxable year.", "name": "section_151c_applies", "roles": ["subject", "claimant", "claimant_taxable_year"]}, {"functional": false, "meaning": "A deduction under section 151 with respect to the subject is allowable to the claimant for the claimant's taxable year.", "name": "deduction_under_151_allowable_to", "roles": ["subject", "claimant", "claimant_taxable_year"]}, {"functional": false, "meaning": "The two expressly supplied persons are different; inequality is never inferred.", "name": "different", "roles": ["left_person", "right_person"]}, {"functional": false, "meaning": "The general section 151(d)(1) exemption-amount rule applies defeasibly to the subject and taxable year.", "name": "section_151d1_applies", "roles": ["subject", "subject_taxable_year"]}, {"functional": false, "meaning": "Section 151(d)(2) applies because a section 151 deduction for the subject is allowable to a different taxpayer for a taxable year beginning in the calendar year in which the subject's taxable year begins.", "name": "section_151d2_applies", "roles": ["subject", "subject_taxable_year", "other_taxpayer", "other_taxpayer_taxable_year", "calendar_year"]}, {"functional": false, "meaning": "The taxable year begins after December 31, 2017, and before January 1, 2026; this factual period classification must be supplied explicitly.", "name": "taxable_year_begins_in_2018_through_2025", "roles": ["taxable_year"]}, {"functional": false, "meaning": "Section 151(d)(5) applies because the subject's taxable year begins after December 31, 2017, and before January 1, 2026.", "name": "section_151d5_applies", "roles": ["subject", "subject_taxable_year"]}, {"functional": true, "meaning": "The final exemption amount applicable to the subject for the subject's taxable year; subject and taxable year form the key and amount is the output.", "name": "exemption_amount", "roles": ["subject", "subject_taxable_year", "amount"]}], "cases": [{"ordinal": 81, "facts": "Alice and Charlie have been married since 2 Feb 2015. Bob counts as Alice's dependent under section 152(c)(1) for 2015.", "query": "Alice can claim an exemption with Bob the dependent for 2015 under section 151(c)."}, {"ordinal": 86, "facts": "Alice has a son, Bob, who satisfies section 152(c)(1) for the year 2015. Bob has a son, Charlie, who satisfies section 152(c)(1) for the year 2015.", "query": "Section 152(b)(1) applies to Bob for the year 2015."}, {"ordinal": 72, "facts": "Alice is entitled to an exemption under section 151(d) for Bob for the year 2015.", "query": "Under section 151(d)(2), Bob's exemption amount for the year 2015 is equal to $2000."}], "expected_ordinals": [81, 86, 72]}
